items.title: Beyond Dice: Evaluating Reliability and Robustness in Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation Under Progressive Speckle Corruption
items.authors: Co-authored — see the submission for the full author list
items.venue: Submitted to the MICCAI 2026 MIRASOL Workshop
items.summary: Benchmarks U-Net, Attention U-Net, TransUNet and SegFormer-B0 for breast ultrasound lesion segmentation under progressive speckle corruption, and applies Monte Carlo Dropout for predictive uncertainty and model reliability assessment.

items.title: West African Traditional Medicine Systems Pharmacology (WATMSP) Platform
items.authors: R. A. Owusu, Prof. Edmund Ekuadzi, Dr. Prince Ebenezer Adjei  et al.
items.summary: An open-access platform integrating phytochemical, molecular, target, ADMET, ethnomedicinal and therapeutic indication data for West African medicinal plants.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence Models for Predicting Outcomes of Lung Pathologies: A Review
items.authors: R. A. Owusu, D. A. Addo
items.summary: A review of machine-learning and artificial-intelligence models applied to the prediction of lung-pathology outcomes, examining model performance, interpretability, generalizability and dataset limitations across biomedical studies.

items.title: DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF A LOW-COST WIRELESS DIGITAL STETHOSCOPE FOR CLINICAL USE IN GHANA
items.authors: Robert Afiakwa Owusu, Dennis Ankomah, Esther Makafui
items.summary: Undergraduate thesis focused on the design and development of a low-cost wireless digital stethoscope for biomedical signal acquisition and remote auscultation.
